mutants.test: test/features/chat/chat_session_test.dart a store appearing restarts a stream stopped for noStore
mutants.why: A store change no longer restarts a stream stopped for noStore or storeClosed.

mutants.why: The unread badge ignores the streamed total.

mutants.test: test/features/chat/chat_thread_notifier_test.dart a message of another buyer is not adopted

mutants.why: The first incoming message is dropped when the thread has no conversation yet.

mutants.test: test/features/chat/chat_conversations_notifier_test.dart refresh merges page 1 into the loaded pages without collapsing them

mutants.test: test/features/chat/chat_conversations_notifier_test.dart a loadMore that finishes after reload is discarded

mutants.why: loadMore builds on its stale snapshot and overwrites a refresh.
